description: This file 'hardware.h' defines hardware-related constants, includes, and function prototypes for SPI configuration and hardware control in an embedded system. It contains macro definitions for SPI baud rate prescalers, function declarations for SPI device management, and conditional code for C++ compatibility and production-specific functions.

methods.name: getSpiDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the SPI driver instance for a specified SPI device.

methods.name: lockSpi
methods.description: Locks the SPI bus for exclusive access to the specified device.

methods.name: unlockSpi
methods.description: Releases the lock on the SPI bus.

methods.name: getMisoPin
methods.description: Returns the pin associated with MISO (Master In Slave Out) for a given SPI device.

methods.name: getMosiPin
methods.description: Returns the pin associated with MOSI (Master Out Slave In) for a given SPI device.

methods.name: getSckPin
methods.description: Returns the SCK (Serial Clock) pin for a given SPI device.

methods.name: showBor
methods.description: Displays or logs the BOR (Brown-Out Reset) status.

methods.name: setBor
methods.description: Sets the BOR (Brown-Out Reset) threshold value.

methods.name: applyNewHardwareSettings
methods.description: Applies new hardware configuration settings (production code only).

methods.name: initHardware
methods.description: Initializes hardware components with logging support (production code only).
